scenes.say: Do you ever fall asleep with your contact lenses on? Watch this first.

scenes.en: Your cornea takes oxygen from the air. A lens on it all night means less oxygen, more germs.
scenes.say: Your cornea gets oxygen from the air. A lens on it all night means less oxygen, and an easier path for germs.

scenes.en: Sleeping in lenses raises the risk of eye infection about 6 to 8 times.
scenes.ta: லென்ஸுடன் தூங்கினால் தொற்று அபாயம் பல மடங்கு அதிகம்
scenes.say: Did you know? Studies show that sleeping in contact lenses raises the risk of an eye infection by about six to eight times.

scenes.en: Wash and dry your hands before touching lenses.
scenes.ta: லென்ஸை தொடும் முன் கைகளை கழுவி துடையுங்கள்
scenes.say: Do: wash and dry your hands before you touch your lenses.

scenes.en: Fresh solution every time. Never top up. New case every 3 months.
scenes.say: Use fresh solution every time, never top up old solution, and replace your lens case at least every three months.

scenes.en: No tap water, no saliva. Remove lenses before swimming or a shower.
scenes.say: Don't rinse lenses with tap water or saliva, and take them out before swimming or a shower. Water can carry harmful germs.

scenes.en: Remove lenses and see an eye specialist urgently.
scenes.ta: கண் சிவந்து வலித்தால், உடனே கண் மருத்துவரை பாருங்கள்
scenes.say: If your eye turns red and painful, or your vision blurs, remove your lenses and see an eye specialist urgently.

scenes.en: Get an eye test before buying lenses.
scenes.say: Always get an eye test and the right fit before you buy lenses. Book yours today.
